description: This file defines a Lua module that implements a JSX-like string builder for creating HTML/XML-like strings with support for tags, properties, and children. It includes utility functions for string manipulation, array operations, and HTML attribute formatting, as well as the main 'luax' function which generates the string representation based on provided tag, properties, and children.

methods.name: utils.is_single_closing
methods.description: Determines if an element is a self-closing tag based on HTML5 specifications.

methods.name: utils.join
methods.description: Joins an array of strings into a single string with an optional separator.

methods.name: utils.map
methods.description: Maps over a data collection, applying a callback to generate a new array of strings or components.

methods.name: utils.match
methods.description: Performs pattern matching with case handling for inline logic, returning corresponding values or executing functions based on key.

methods.name: utils.split
methods.description: Splits a string into an array based on a separator.

methods.name: utils.filter
methods.description: Filters a numeric table based on a callback condition.

methods.name: utils.merge
methods.description: Merges two tables into a new table, combining key-value pairs.

methods.name: utils.insert
methods.description: Inserts a string segment into another string at a specific position.

methods.name: utils.format_props
methods.description: Formats a properties table into an attribute string for HTML/XML tags.

methods.name: utils.children_to_string
methods.description: Converts children elements (strings or tables) into a single string suitable for HTML/XML rendering.

methods.name: luax
methods.description: Main function that builds HTML/XML-like strings with support for tags, attributes, self-closing tags, and children. It also supports being called directly via metatable to handle flexible argument passing.
